verdict.rationale: The install docs say GlitchTip can be run with Docker, with Docker Compose recommended, and the CLI docs show logging into your own instance URL. Community users independently report that self-hosting is easy and stable, needing only four components (backend, workers, Redis, Postgres), though one user found deployment 'a bit hard'. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party install and upgrade documentation in the pack (only a single install line), explicit evidence of an open-source license for the self-hosted code.
